narrative.overview: Jornada is an operational employee platform, not a marketing SaaS dashboard. The interface should feel like a compact command surface used every day by employees, support teams, and administrators: calm, dense, legible, and precise. The visual world is dark-first, graphite-based, and lightly branded with a wine red accent. The space background is identity, not decoration: it can sit behind the shell, stars, planets, and satellites, but the working panels must stay solid enough for reading and repeated use.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first graphite surfaces with a controlled light mode.
Wine red used as rare operational accent.
Low blur, low transparency, and no glass-card excess.
One reusable surface system across Inbox, Atendimentos, Configuracao, Formularios, Perfil, Programacao, and Vencimentos.

rules.name: The No Rogue Blue Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce blue badges, links, buttons, or row highlights in the admin shell unless a future brand decision creates a blue token.

rules.name: The Surface Level Rule
rules.body: Elements at the same visual level use the same surface token across every page.

rules.name: The Accent Scarcity Rule
rules.body: Wine red marks state or priority. It is not a general fill color for decorative blocks.

rules.name: The Compact Copy Rule
rules.body: App surfaces should prefer short labels and row-first content over explanatory paragraphs.

rules.name: The Heading Restraint Rule
rules.body: No hero-scale type inside the app shell. Content density wins.

rules.name: The Solid Panel Rule
rules.body: A working panel must be readable without relying on the background image. If the planets compete with text, the panel is too transparent.

rules.name: The Background Is Secondary Rule
rules.body: Stars, planets, satellites, and parallax are allowed behind the app, but they must never become the primary information layer.

rules.name: The Low-Glare Light Rule
rules.body: Light mode uses cool gray surfaces with controlled brightness instead of pure-white shells, cards, lists, or page backgrounds.

rules.name: The Support Conversation Rule
rules.body: Support detail screens prioritize the message thread. Metadata, field values, ratings, and operational actions stay in a desktop side panel or a compact mobile details disclosure.

dos: Do use SectionCard for top-level app cards and panels.
Do use --admin-surface-1, --admin-surface-2, and --admin-surface-3 by visual level.
Do keep controls compact and aligned like rows/tables.
Do use React Aria Components for accessible behavior where we own the visual component.
Do isolate AntD/Formily inside the designer route.
Do validate dark and light mode whenever a new surface token is added.
donts: Don't create page-local rgba() surfaces when an admin surface token already exists.
Don't use pure white shells, cards, lists, or page backgrounds in the admin app.
Don't use blue links, badges, row highlights, or buttons in the admin shell.
Don't use large rounded SaaS cards for operational pages.
Don't make the background more important than the content.
Don't rely on frontend menu hiding as permission control.
